notes.title: Blink the Bulb - Version 1.02
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes for Blink the Bulb version 1.02:[/h1]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

*Fixed a glitch that distorted Blink's sprite while ducking during idle animations

*Fixed a glitch where using the Egglight's special ability on the bouncy figgy puddings in Winter Land failed to cancel the ability

notes.title: Blink the Bulb - Version 1.01
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes for Blink the Bulb version 1.01[/h1]

[b]Features/tweaks:[/b]

*Added Steam achievements

*Slightly increased the damage Blink's double jump deals to enemies on contact

*Increased shield duration for Lamppost Head active item

*Increased zombie life duration for Brain Food passive item

*Zombies spawned from Brain Food passive item will now destroy most physical/spike damage type projectiles on contact

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

*Fixed a bug with the Cupid Arrow passive that could crash the game if it incorrectly tried to home in on a defeated enemy

*Fixed a bug in Love Land 1 where the player could clip through a one-way floor

*Added a missing tile graphic in Winter Land 2

*Fixed a visual bug that prevented Egg Land 1's daytime miniboss from entering its defeat pose

Version 1.02 of the game will feature an option to use the keyboard when a gamepad is detected. If you have any other features you'd like to see feel free to ask.
